js: const cands=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter(x=>/close|dismiss/i.test(x.getAttribute('aria-label')||'')); const b=cands[0]; if(b){b.click(); return 'closed:'+b.getAttribute('aria-label');} return 'no close; buttons='+Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).map(x=>(x.getAttribute('aria-label')||x.innerText.trim())).filter(Boolean).slice(0,25).join('|');
const b=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x=>x.innerText.trim().startsWith('Bench Press')); if(b){b.click(); return 'added bench';} return 'no bench button';

const el=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input')).find(i=>/set 1 reps$/i.test(i.getAttribute('aria-label')||'')); if(!el) return 'no reps input: '+Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input')).map(i=>i.getAttribute('aria-label')).join('|'); const s=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set; s.call(el,'8'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return 'reps set, value='+el.value;

const c=document.querySelector('[aria-label="Mark set 1 complete"]'); if(!c) return 'no check: '+Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[aria-label^="Mark set"]')).map(x=>x.getAttribute('aria-label')).join('|'); c.click(); return 'ticked';
const b=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x=>x.innerText.trim()==='Not yet'); if(!b) return 'no prompt'; b.click(); return 'not yet clicked';
const k=document.querySelector('[aria-label="Exercise options"]'); if(!k) return 'no kebab'; k.click(); return 'kebab';

const b=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x=>/^cancel workout$/i.test(x.innerText.trim())); if(!b) return 'no cancel item: '+Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).map(x=>x.innerText.trim()).filter(Boolean).join('|'); b.click(); return 'cancel item clicked';

const bs=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter(x=>/^cancel workout$/i.test(x.innerText.trim())); const b=bs[bs.length-1]; if(!b) return 'no confirm'; b.click(); return 'confirmed cancel ('+bs.length+' match)';
